answer: Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. The tundra is small, but the toll is a waiting period of 30 days that no payment can shorten, and the toll is charged per name, not per farm. Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Minted bard dial seal sees to it, since a seal bards renew after verse reviews. A farm cannot share one proof across a hundred names, so its costs multiply while its reward stays single. The tally keeps mirror. marble stays on the record.
